summary: Backend-only testing for Auto Abodes. Created comprehensive pytest suite (30 tests) covering auth (register/login/me) for all 4 roles, admin auto-upgrade for aestheticabodesyyc@gmail.com (role=admin, tier=business, ads_enabled=false), subscription upgrade with ads_enabled toggling (free=true, pro/business=false), profile updates (name/phone/bio/qualifications/hourly_rate/auto_accept), full job lifecycle (post-only by owner/client/owner_cleaner/admin with cleaner getting 403; scope filters mine/available/assigned with qualification subset filtering; apply with qualification gating; auto-accept assignment; manual assign restricted to poster; checkin; checklist with 5 mandatory photos + tasks; complete fails on incomplete then succeeds; stats reflect logged hours), chat (idempotent conversation creation, send/list messages, conversation list with other-participant info), and /users listing excluding self. All 30 tests passed (100%) against the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.
action_items: No backend action items - all 30 tests pass. Email is lowercased on register/login (correct, observed in /api/auth/me) - clients should be aware of this normalization.
Google OAuth (/api/auth/google), AdMob ads, and Stripe billing were not tested per request scope (mocked/external).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 537 lines - close to but still under the 700-line guideline. Consider modularizing (auth, jobs, chat, teams) when adding more features.

complete_job derives hours from (now - checked_in_at); a checkin followed by immediate complete yields ~0.0 hours and pay=0. Logged values are honest but front-end may want minimum threshold or to fall back to estimated_duration when elapsed is <some threshold. Current code's fallback `or job.get('estimated_duration', 0)` only triggers when elapsed exactly rounds to 0.0, which is fragile.

assign_job uses $addToSet on assigned_cleaners with no cap and doesn't verify cleaner has required qualifications - poster could assign any cleaner_id including one who never applied. Consider validating the user_id is in applicants and meets requirements.

apply_job auto-accept condition allows the FIRST qualifying applicant with auto_accept to grab the job; subsequent applicants are added to applicants. This matches spec but means race-condition winners are non-deterministic (acceptable).
list_jobs filters `available` jobs by qualifications client-side after a DB fetch; for scale, consider an indexed query. Not a bug.
Pydantic v1 .dict() used; on Pydantic v2 this still works but is deprecated - consider model_dump().
No rate limiting / brute-force protection on /auth/login.
Sessions never extend on use; the 7-day expiry is fine but consider sliding window.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed users and jobs each run (random uuid suffixes) and the admin (aestheticabodesyyc@gmail.com) is registered/logged-in. No production data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use pytest /app/backend/tests/test_auto_abodes.py. BASE_URL comes from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. The admin email (aestheticabodesyyc@gmail.com) is now created with password 'admin123'. Test users are TEST_-prefixed for easy cleanup. Skipped (per scope): /api/auth/google (needs Emergent session_id), ads banner, Stripe billing.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found in scope.
